entry.title: DrLogueXXL 0.2.1
entry.summary: Hybrid drum machine modelled on the KORG drumlogue (not affiliated with KORG): analogue-style kick, snare and toms, six sample parts with 192 synthesised sounds and your own WAVs, a MULTI part with VPM, noise and six open logue SDK units, delay, reverb and master effects, choke groups, a mixer and four macros, on a panel in the machine's look.
